blocks.html: In its desire to bring government services in one convenient location closer to the public, Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center (RMLPC) recently opened Business One Stop Shop (BOSS) Registration at the Cinema Lobby, Upper Ground Floor of Robinsons Place Antipolo from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM until January 31, 2021.

The local government of Antipolo City has started the Business One Stop Shop (BOSS) Registration that aims to simplify and speed up the processing of permits of individual or companies operating businesses within the city.
BOSS Registration offer services such as new business permit applications, renewal of business permits, and assessment on business permit renewals.

With this innovation, the public now only has to process their documents by simply bringing the basic requirements for applications (new and renewal) which are: Application Form, DTI Business Name Registration/SEC Registration, Baranggay Business Clearance, TCT or Tax Declaration (Contract of Lease if renting), Community Tax Certificate (Sedula/Corporate Tax Certificate), Financial Documents, and Tax Clearance.
As Robinsons Malls strictly follows the recommended public health guidelines, Antipolo QR Pass is required prior to entry and wearing of face mask and full face shield is a must.

For more information, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or its Facebook page RobPlaceAntipolo; or follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
